bill_review_points: quantile operating points use future scores: pilot uses p >= 0.5 only
last 20 sessions have immature E_close20: predicted but excluded from scoring and from negative labels (also F2 query outcomes)
resource arithmetic: dense codes 56 GiB / sparse 5.6 GiB for 10 versions; state fits up to 344,340 rows: split a small pilot from the later 5-replicate run

pilot shape: replicate 0, two wirings, <= 256 rows per generated train path and 64 per check/test path pre-selected without labels, one 2026 forward fold, 7 fits, 8 preset F2 queries, CPU 1 / 300 s / RAM 2 GiB / output 256 MiB, sparse caches and abort rules

generated_manifest.observed_hashes: per path in the manifest, verified before any read
generated_manifest.hidden_use: regime at the selected rows only, read by the state-target builder; never by encoder, forward-risk or retrieval code

inputs_pinned.real_vintage: retrospective_latest_vintage; effective fetch = earliest file field; last complete session 2026-11-05; 2026-11-06 row dropped; label availability modeled = event end + 60 s (regular-session assumption, declared)

flybrake_reference.reused: wiring semantics and sparse top-k code semantics only

eligibility_and_features.features: council_io.features (10 dims, frozen order); eligible iff status ok
eligibility_and_features.maturity_split_real: E_close20 is mature at the data end only for D <= index(2026-11-05) - 20; sessions with D in the last 20 are 'predict-only': scored outputs are written but excluded from every metric and never counted as negatives
eligibility_and_features.generated: eligible per path by the same feature rule; E_close20 for generated paths is not used in the pilot

label_free_row_preselection.rule: row positions are chosen from the eligible index list of each path by fixed stride before any label is read: stride = max(1, floor(n_eligible / m)); positions = eligible[0], eligible[stride], ... until m rows; m = 256 for train paths, 64 for check and test paths; the selection code never opens hidden/*.npz

counts.real_rows_encoded: all eligible real sessions (about 5,739) for the forward fold and F2

label_free_row_preselection.recorded: the selected positions per path are written to the results with the manifest hash so bill can reproduce the selection

encoder_pilot.scaler: per-feature mean and population std on eligible real sessions D <= 2014-12-30 only; arrays stored
encoder_pilot.projection_P: 344 x 10 Gaussian N(0, 1/10) from default_rng(SeedSequence([20261107, 80, 0])) (80 = declared code for 'P'); shared by both wirings

wirings.connectome: PN->KC from mb_right.npz, row-normalised (flybrake.wiring semantics re-implemented, hash-checked input)
wirings.rewired: per-row degree-matched random rewiring from SeedSequence([20261107, 87, 0]) (87 = declared code for 'W'); same P, scaler, data order and readout initialisation

encoder_pilot.activation: pn = relu(x_scaled @ P.T); a = pn @ W.T (theta = 0 fixed); top-k k = 129; z = sparse / L2; all-non-positive a -> abstain row (counted, excluded from fits and retrieval)
encoder_pilot.identity: encoder_version_id = sha256(code version, feature order, scaler arrays, P bytes, W bytes, theta bytes, k, constants, connectome sha); two versions in the pilot
encoder_pilot.storage: sparse only: per code 129 int16 indices + 129 float32 values (774 bytes); dense activations exist only per batch of <= 1,024 rows (<= 10.6 MiB); caches work/council_phase1_pilot_v1/codes/{version_id}/{real|path_id}.npz written once
encoder_pilot.arithmetic: codes: real 5,739 + generated 17,920 = 23,659 per version x 2 versions = 47,318 codes = about 35 MiB sparse; W 2,597 x 344 float32 = 3.6 MiB; peak RAM well under 2 GiB

F1_state_pilot.target: S_generated_state_at_D mapped down={descent,crash}, up={ascent,rebound}, neutral={sideways,highvol} (declared mapping); labels read only for the preselected rows
fits: Fly-connectome multinomial logistic readout on z (2,597 -> 3)
native multinomial logistic on the 10 scaled features
F1_state_pilot.solver: numpy full-batch gradient descent, L2 lambda = 1.0, learning rate 0.5 on mean loss, 200 iterations, zero init, float64 accumulators; deterministic; the same solver for all three
F1_state_pilot.evaluation: confusion matrix, per-class precision/recall, macro-F1 on check (1,280 rows) and test (1,280 rows) separately; per combination id breakdown; no threshold choice

F1_forward_risk_pilot.target: E_close20 on real sessions via council_io.label_e_close20 and gated_label (replay clock)
F1_forward_risk_pilot.fold: 2026 only: fit cutoff = modeled confirmation of the last session before 2026-01-02 (2025-12-30 15:31:00+09:00, B schedule); training rows = eligible real sessions whose E_close20 availability <= cutoff; scoring rows = eligible 2026 sessions with D <= index(2026-11-05) - 20 (mature at data end); predict-only rows = the last 20 eligible sessions (written, not scored)
fits: native logistic on the 10 scaled features

T_forward LightGBM on the 10 features: binary objective, num_leaves 7, max_depth 3, learning_rate .05, min_data_in_leaf 200, lambda_l2 1, 200 rounds, seed 0, num_threads 1, deterministic, force_col_wise
F1_forward_risk_pilot.solver_logistic: same numpy solver as the state pilot (binary)
F1_forward_risk_pilot.operating_point: p >= 0.5 only; no quantile thresholds in the pilot (a quantile threshold would need freezing on pre-cutoff data in a later spec)
F1_forward_risk_pilot.metrics: on the 2026 scored rows: positives, negatives, precision, recall, false-alarm rate at 0.5; log-loss and Brier reported with calibration_status uncalibrated; detection delay for events whose start lies in the scored set; the scored-set size and the predict-only count are reported

F2_retrieval_pilot.queries: 8 preset decision sessions chosen without labels: the first eligible session of each year 2019..2026
F2_retrieval_pilot.candidates: real sessions s with s < D, E_close20 availability (replay clock) <= decision_at of D, same encoder version, finite non-zero code, outcome {event, ret20, max_dd} from council_io labels; council_io.retrieve k = 10, min_separation = 21, target E_close20
F2_retrieval_pilot.query_outcomes: the realised E_close20 at D is reported only if mature at data end (D <= index(2026-11-05) - 20); otherwise marked immature and excluded from comparison
F2_retrieval_pilot.outputs: per query: returned cases with similarity, label_end_index, outcome, max_drawdown_in_window; similarity_spread; eligible/returned counts; comparison of retrieved event share vs realised event where mature; descriptive only

budget_and_caps.ram_check: process RSS sampled after each batch/fit; exceeding the cap aborts
budget_and_caps.estimated_wall: under 2 minutes (encoding 47k codes; 3 multinomial fits on 15,360 x 2,597 sparse-to-dense batches; 4 binary fits on <= 2,500 rows)

abort_rules: any input hash mismatch before start
any fit row whose label is not available at the fit cutoff
any hidden/*.npz read outside the state-target builder
time, RAM or output cap exceeded
on abort: preserve partial outputs and a failure record; no retry, no changed settings

outputs.results: council_phase1_pilot_results.json written once (xb) with all hashes, encoder version ids, row selections, metrics, F2 records and limitations
outputs.runlog: work/council_phase1_pilot_runlog_<UTC>.json outside the output directory: thread env, UTC start/end, exit, stdout/stderr, before/after hashes of code, inputs and connectome, RSS peak
outputs.selftests_before_approval: fixture-only: toy connectome (6 PN, 20 KC), toy paths <= 64 rows, toy real series <= 400 rows; checks: encoder determinism and version-id sensitivity to every component, rewiring degree match per row, scaler from prefix only, label-free preselection reproducibility, purge by availability clock at the 2026 cutoff, predict-only exclusion from metrics and negatives, retrieval candidate clocks, solver convergence on a separable toy, RAM/output cap enforcement with tiny caps

follow_up_not_in_this_document: the 5-replicate run (replicates 0..4, all 12 forward folds, full state rows) is a separate spec after the pilot audit; its resource plan must use sparse caches and streaming fits
limitations_stated_in_results: no real current-trend ground truth: state heads scored only on generated regimes under a declared mapping
forward-risk results are one retrospective year on latest-vintage data with overlapping windows; no significance claim
connectome vs rewired is one replicate pair in the pilot
F2 similarity is resemblance, not prediction
nothing here is an operating or profitability claim
open_for_bill: solver: numpy gradient descent (200 iterations, lr 0.5) vs L-BFGS
the 8 F2 query sessions as drafted (first eligible session of 2019..2026)
LightGBM comparison expert included (drafted yes, 1 fit)
